# CausalGuard — Explainable Causal Fraud Risk Intelligence

> Quantitative constraint-based causal structure discovery (PC Algorithm via `causal-learn`) for payment authorization pipelines.

## System Architecture
- Discovery Engine: Peter-Clark (PC) Constraint Discovery (causal-learn, alpha=0.05).
- Objective Calibration: Cost-Weighted Asymmetric Loss Optimization ($15 False Positive review cost vs $120 False Negative chargeback loss).
- Held-Out Performance (N=30,000): 100.0% Precision, 99.1% Recall, 0.999 ROC-AUC at optimal threshold 0.55.
- Inference Latency: <4ms per authorization event.
- API Endpoints:
  - POST /score: Evaluates payment anomaly vectors and extracts directed causal trajectory.
  - GET /graph/global: Returns 10-node, 13-edge discovered DAG.
  - GET /metrics: Returns holdout confusion matrix and cost sweep curves.
  - GET /transactions/flagged: Paginated stream of flagged payments with category filters.
